title: 40. Reverse Linked List

examples.explanation: Reversing the linked list [1,2,3,4,5] gives the reversed order [5,4,3,2,1].
Reversing the linked list [1,2] gives the reversed order [2,1].
The list is empty, so the reversed list is also empty.
